compositionEvidence.summary: Corrected seven accepted WebGPU-safe modules into a darker all-over field with the missing dark-violet atmospheric part restored and fixed-camera framing solved through part transforms.
decisions: Camera fields are copied unchanged from the task contract; no camera or projection repair is claimed.
Restored dark-violet-atmospheric-field as the visible deep-atmospheric ground before grid, radial, current, mark, and pressure layers.
Reduced and offset the densest mark and luminous-pressure layers so the desktop stays edge-to-edge but the result is less like one flat white panel.
Kept final grade renderer-owned: one outputColorTransform with lower exposure, modest contrast, and no material-level tone compensation.

takeaways: Route this as final image treatment plus fixed-view validation, not new geometry or module source work.
Use a single renderer-owned grade after accepted modules; avoid stacked material/post exposure fixes.
Use the mandated desktop, mobile, and surround-360 preview reports as fixed-camera evidence.
